LIST r, n, erf, j FROM Artifactscore has ArtifactscoreArtregistry r
  AND ALSO has ArtifactscoreArtname n
  AND ALSO is of Sensitivitydata sd
  AND ALSO sd has SensitivitydataEnvsensitivity es
  AND ALSO sd has SensitivitydataLightsensitivity ls
  AND ALSO sd has SensitivitydataTempsensitivity ts
  AND ALSO sd has SensitivitydataHumiditysensitivity hs
  AND ALSO (if(starts_with(es,'High'),10,if(starts_with(es,'Medium'),5,1)) + if(ls='High',10,if(ls='Medium',5,1)) + if(ts='High',10,if(ts='Medium',5,1)) + if(hs='High',10,if(hs='Medium',5,1))) / 4 AS erf
  AND ALSO concat(if(starts_with(es,'High'), '{"type": "EnvSensitivity", "value": "High"},', ''), if(ls='High', '{"type": "LightSensitivity", "value": "High"},', ''), if(ts='High', '{"type": "TempSensitivity", "value": "High"},', ''), if(hs='High', '{"type": "HumiditySensitivity", "value": "High"},', '')) AS parts
  AND ALSO json(concat('[', substr(parts, 1, length(parts) - 1), ']')) AS j
  WHERE erf > 7 ORDERED WITH erf DESCENDING

DEFINE HistRank ::= LIST ar, rh FROM Artifactrating ar has ArtifactratingHistsignrating h AND ALSO 1 AS one AND ALSO THE RANK OF h WITHIN one AS rh
DEFINE CultRank ::= LIST ar, rc FROM Artifactrating ar has ArtifactratingCultscore c AND ALSO 1 AS uno AND ALSO THE RANK OF c WITHIN uno AS rc
LIST r, n, iv, cst, cat FROM Artifactscore has ArtifactscoreArtregistry r
  AND ALSO has ArtifactscoreArtname n
  AND ALSO has ArtifactscoreConservestatus cst
  AND ALSO is of Artifactsecurityaccess sa AND ALSO sa has ArtifactsecurityaccessInsvalueusd iv
  AND ALSO is of Artifactrating ar
  AND ALSO ar has HistRank HistRankRh rh
  AND ALSO ar has CultRank CultRankRc rc
  AND ALSO if(iv > 1000000, 'Monetary High-Value', if(rh <= THE COUNT OF Artifactrating / 10 AND rc <= THE COUNT OF Artifactrating / 10, 'Cultural/Historical High-Value', 'Other')) AS cat
  WHERE cst = 'Critical' AND (iv > 1000000 OR (rh <= THE COUNT OF Artifactrating / 10 AND rc <= THE COUNT OF Artifactrating / 10))

LIST d, tot, adq, ins, cbe, st FROM Artifactscore has ArtifactscoreArtdynasty d
  AND ALSO has ArtifactscoreConservestatus cst
  AND ALSO is of Artifactrating ar
  AND ALSO ar has ArtifactratingHistsignrating hsr
  AND ALSO ar has ArtifactratingResearchvalrating rvr
  AND ALSO ar has ArtifactratingCultscore cs
  AND ALSO is artrefmaintained of Conservationandmaintenance cm
  AND ALSO cm has ConservationandmaintenanceBudgetallocstatus bas
  AND ALSO ((hsr + rvr + cs) * (10 - if(cst = 'Excellent', 1, if(cst = 'Good', 3, if(cst = 'Fair', 5, if(cst = 'Poor', 7, 10)))))) / 30 AS cpi
  AND ALSO (cpi * cpi) AS wp
  AND ALSO if(bas = 'Adequate', 1, 0) AS adqf
  AND ALSO if(bas = 'Insufficient', 1, 0) AS insf
  AND ALSO if(cst = 'Critical' AND bas = 'Insufficient', 1, 0) AS crf
  AND ALSO 1 AS one
  AND ALSO THE SUM OF cpi GROUPED BY d AS tot
  AND ALSO THE SUM OF wp GROUPED BY d AS swp
  AND ALSO THE SUM OF one GROUPED BY d AS n
  AND ALSO THE SUM OF adqf GROUPED BY d AS adq
  AND ALSO THE SUM OF insf GROUPED BY d AS ins
  AND ALSO THE SUM OF crf GROUPED BY d AS cr
  AND ALSO (swp / (tot * n)) AS cbe
  AND ALSO if(cbe < 0.5 AND cr > 0, 'Budget Crisis', 'Within Budget') AS st

LIST r, n, mt, ls, st FROM Artifactscore has ArtifactscoreArtregistry r
  AND ALSO has ArtifactscoreArtname n
  AND ALSO has ArtifactscoreMattype mt
  AND ALSO is of Sensitivitydata sd
  AND ALSO sd has SensitivitydataLightsensitivity ls
  AND ALSO is of Usagerecord ur
  AND ALSO ur has Showcase sc
  AND ALSO sc is of Environmentalreadingscore er
  AND ALSO er is of Lightandradiationreading lrd
  AND ALSO lrd has LightandradiationreadingLightlux lux
  AND ALSO if(lux > if(ls = 'High', 50, 200), 'Over Exposure', 'Within Limits') AS st
  WHERE ls = 'High' OR ls = 'Medium'

LIST r, n, mt, dur, dsd, erps, rec FROM Artifactscore has ArtifactscoreArtregistry r
  AND ALSO has ArtifactscoreArtname n
  AND ALSO has ArtifactscoreMattype mt
  AND ALSO has ArtifactscoreConservestatus cst
  AND ALSO is of Artifactrating ar
  AND ALSO ar has ArtifactratingHistsignrating hsr
  AND ALSO ar has ArtifactratingResearchvalrating rvr
  AND ALSO ar has ArtifactratingCultscore cs
  AND ALSO is of Sensitivitydata sd
  AND ALSO sd has SensitivitydataLightsensitivity ls
  AND ALSO sd has SensitivitydataTempsensitivity ts
  AND ALSO sd has SensitivitydataHumiditysensitivity hs
  AND ALSO is of Usagerecord ur
  AND ALSO ur has UsagerecordDisplaydurmonths dur
  AND ALSO ur has UsagerecordDisplayrotatesched drs
  AND ALSO ur has Showcase sc
  AND ALSO sc is of Environmentalreadingscore er
  AND ALSO er is of Lightandradiationreading lrd
  AND ALSO lrd has LightandradiationreadingLightlux lux
  AND ALSO lrd has LightandradiationreadingVisibleexplxh vex
  AND ALSO (36 * (10 - if(ls='High',10,if(ls='Medium',5,1))) * (10 - if(ts='High',10,if(ts='Medium',5,1))) * (10 - if(hs='High',10,if(hs='Medium',5,1)))) / 1000 AS dsd
  AND ALSO (lux * if(ls='High',10,if(ls='Medium',5,1)) * vex) / 1000 AS ler
  AND ALSO ((hsr + rvr + cs) * (10 - if(cst = 'Excellent', 1, if(cst = 'Good', 3, if(cst = 'Fair', 5, if(cst = 'Poor', 7, 10)))))) / 30 AS cpi
  AND ALSO (((dsd - dur) * (ler + 1)) * (cpi + 1)) / 100 AS erpsraw
  AND ALSO round(erpsraw, 2) AS erps
  AND ALSO if(erpsraw < 0, 'Immediate Rotation', 'Monitor') AS rec
  WHERE starts_with(drs, 'Active')

LIST r, n, t, rh, hc, ad FROM Artifactscore has ArtifactscoreArtregistry r
  AND ALSO has ArtifactscoreArtname n
  AND ALSO has ArtifactscoreArtageyears ay
  AND ALSO is of Sensitivitydata sd
  AND ALSO sd has SensitivitydataEnvsensitivity es
  AND ALSO sd has SensitivitydataLightsensitivity ls
  AND ALSO sd has SensitivitydataTempsensitivity ts
  AND ALSO sd has SensitivitydataHumiditysensitivity hs
  AND ALSO is of Usagerecord ur
  AND ALSO ur has Showcase sc
  AND ALSO sc is of Environmentalreadingscore er
  AND ALSO er has EnvironmentalreadingscoreTempc t
  AND ALSO er has EnvironmentalreadingscoreRelhumidity rh
  AND ALSO (if(starts_with(es,'High'),10,if(starts_with(es,'Medium'),5,1)) + if(ls='High',10,if(ls='Medium',5,1)) + if(ts='High',10,if(ts='Medium',5,1)) + if(hs='High',10,if(hs='Medium',5,1))) / 4 AS erf
  AND ALSO (if(starts_with(es,'High'),1,0) + if(ls='High',1,0) + if(ts='High',1,0) + if(hs='High',1,0)) AS hc
  AND ALSO (ay * erf * power(rh - 50, 2) * t) / 100000 AS mdr
  AND ALSO if(mdr > 5 AND hc >= 2, 'Yes', 'No') AS ad

LIST r FROM DISTINCT Showcase has ShowcaseRegistry r
  AND ALSO has ShowcaseLeakrate lr
  AND ALSO has ShowcaseSealcondition sec
  AND ALSO has ShowcaseMaintstatus ms
  AND ALSO has ShowcaseFilterstatus fs
  AND ALSO has ShowcaseSilicagelstatus sgs
  AND ALSO is of Environmentalreadingscore er
  AND ALSO er has EnvironmentalreadingscoreTempvar24h tv
  AND ALSO er has EnvironmentalreadingscoreHumvar24h hv
  AND ALSO (10 - ((tv + (hv / 5) + lr) / 3)) AS sesr
  AND ALSO (if(sec = 'Poor', 1, 0) + if(starts_with(ms, 'Overdue'), 1, 0) + if(starts_with(fs, 'Replace Now'), 1, 0) + if(starts_with(sgs, 'Replace Now'), 1, 0)) AS flags
  WHERE sesr < 4 OR flags >= 3

LIST r FROM DISTINCT Showcase has ShowcaseRegistry r
  AND ALSO is of Environmentalreadingscore er
  AND ALSO er has EnvironmentalreadingscoreTempvar24h tv
  AND ALSO er has EnvironmentalreadingscoreHumvar24h hv
  WHERE tv > 1 OR hv > 3

LIST r, n, d, cpi FROM Artifactscore has ArtifactscoreArtregistry r
  AND ALSO has ArtifactscoreArtname n
  AND ALSO has ArtifactscoreArtdynasty d
  AND ALSO has ArtifactscoreConservestatus cst
  AND ALSO is of Artifactrating ar
  AND ALSO ar has ArtifactratingHistsignrating hsr
  AND ALSO ar has ArtifactratingResearchvalrating rvr
  AND ALSO ar has ArtifactratingCultscore cs
  AND ALSO ((hsr + rvr + cs) * (10 - if(cst = 'Excellent', 1, if(cst = 'Good', 3, if(cst = 'Fair', 5, if(cst = 'Poor', 7, 10)))))) / 30 AS cpi
  ORDERED WITH cpi DESCENDING

LIST r, tetl FROM Artifactscore has ArtifactscoreArtregistry r
  AND ALSO has ArtifactscoreArtageyears ay
  AND ALSO is of Sensitivitydata sd
  AND ALSO sd has SensitivitydataEnvsensitivity es
  AND ALSO sd has SensitivitydataLightsensitivity ls
  AND ALSO sd has SensitivitydataTempsensitivity ts
  AND ALSO sd has SensitivitydataHumiditysensitivity hs
  AND ALSO is of Usagerecord ur
  AND ALSO ur has Showcase sc
  AND ALSO sc is of Environmentalreadingscore er
  AND ALSO er has EnvironmentalreadingscoreTempc t
  AND ALSO er has EnvironmentalreadingscoreRelhumidity rh
  AND ALSO er is of Lightandradiationreading lrd
  AND ALSO lrd has LightandradiationreadingLightlux lux
  AND ALSO lrd has LightandradiationreadingVisibleexplxh vex
  AND ALSO (if(starts_with(es,'High'),10,if(starts_with(es,'Medium'),5,1)) + if(ls='High',10,if(ls='Medium',5,1)) + if(ts='High',10,if(ts='Medium',5,1)) + if(hs='High',10,if(hs='Medium',5,1))) / 4 AS erf
  AND ALSO (lux * if(ls='High',10,if(ls='Medium',5,1)) * vex) / 1000 AS ler
  AND ALSO (ay * erf * power(rh - 50, 2) * t) / 100000 AS mdr
  AND ALSO round(erf + ler + (mdr * 2), 2) AS tetl
  ORDERED WITH tetl DESCENDING THE FIRST 10
